content: तेजस् {%n.%} [तिज्-भावे करुणादै असुन्] .²1 Sharpness. .²2 The sharp edge (of a knife <ab>&c.</ab>). .²3 The point or top of a flame. .²4 Heat, glow, glare. .²5 Lustre, light, brilliance, splendour; दिनान्ते निहितं तेजः <ls>R. 4. 1</ls>; तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ <ls>Bg. 7. 9</ls>, <ls n="Bg. 7.">10</ls>. .²6 Heat or light considered as the third of the five elements of creation (the other four being पृथिवी, अप्, वायु and आकाश). .²7 The bright appearance of the human body, beauty; अरिष्टशम्यां परितो विसारिणा सुजन्मनस्तस्य निजेन तेजसा <ls>R. 3. 15</ls>. .²8 Fire of energy; शमप्रधानेषु तपोधनेषु गूढं हि दाहात्मकमस्ति तेजः <ls>Ś. 2. 7</ls>; <ls>U. 6. 14</ls>. .²9 Might, prowess, strength, courage, valour, martial or heroic lustre; तेजस्तेजसि शाम्यतु <ls>U. 5. 7</ls>; <ls>Ś. 7. 15</ls>. .²10 One possessed of heroic lustre; तेजसां हि न वयः समीक्ष्यते <ls>R. 11. 1</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 328</ls>, <ls n="Pt.">3. 33</ls>. .²11 Spirit, energy. .²12 Strength of character, not bearing insult or ill-treatment with impunity. .²13 Majestic lustre, majesty, dignity, authority, consequence; तेजोविशेषानुमितां (राजलक्ष्मीं) दधानः <ls>R. 2. 7</ls>. .²14 Semen, seed, semen virile; स्याद्रक्षणीयं यदि मे न तेजः <ls>R. 14. 65</ls>, <ls n="R.">2. 75</ls>; दुष्यन्तेनाहितं तेजो दधानां भूतये भुवः <ls>Ś. 4. 3</ls>. .²15 The essential nature of anything. .²16 Essence, quintessence. .²17 Spiritual, moral, or magical power. .²18 Fire; यज्ञसेनस्य दुहिता तेज एव तु केवलम् <ls>Mb. 3. 239. 9</ls>. .²19 Marrow. .²20 Bile. .²21 The speed of a horse. .²22 Fresh butter. .²23 Gold. .²24 Clearness of the eyes. .²25 A shining or luminous body, light; ऋते कृशानोर्न हि मन्त्रपूतमर्हन्ति तेजांस्यपराणि हव्यम् <ls>Ku. 1. 51</ls>; <ls>Ś. 4. 2</ls>. .²26 The heating and strengthening faculty of the human frame seated in the bile (पित्त). .²27 The brain. .²28 Violence, fierceness. .²29 Impatience. .²30 Anger; मित्रैः सह विरोधं च प्राप्नुते तेजसा वृतः <ls>Mb. 3. 28. 18</ls>. .²31 The sun; उपप्लवांस्तथा घोरान् शशिनस्तेजसस्तथा <ls>Mb. 12. 301. 36</ls>.
